findings.sourceFact: Orders confirmed by noon qualify for same-day dispatch.
findings.candidateIssue: The candidate limits the promise to orders confirmed before noon.
findings.whyItChangesMeaning: An order confirmed exactly at noon is covered by the source but excluded by the candidate.

findings.sourceFact: The recorder asked Niko to end the heater test in another room.
findings.candidateIssue: The candidate says Niko was asked to continue the test in another room.
findings.whyItChangesMeaning: Ending a test and continuing it are different requested actions, even though both place the test in another room.

findings.sourceFact: Successful restart recovery may take up to and including three minutes.
findings.candidateIssue: The candidate requires recovery in under three minutes.
findings.whyItChangesMeaning: A recovery completed at exactly three minutes satisfies the source threshold but fails the candidate threshold.
